trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list and this one unlocks by itself, last of all. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, then collectibles and activities — and check the progress bar at the top of this guide to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and see it through to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn — just follow the on-screen objectives.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Keep playing the story missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Story missions can be replayed from the mission menu, so nothing here can be missed — just play through to the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. Keep following the story missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. You are nearly at the finale now — play the remaining story missions and the chapter trophy pops at its close.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. It is a gold trophy, so it marks the end of the main story — play it when you are ready, and keep a save from before it in case you want to revisit the ending later.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Follow the mission objectives as they appear; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to have a setup phase first — finish the setups, then the heist itself, and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks as part of the story — play the missions in order and it will come up on its own.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the objectives through to the end of the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Finish the takedown as the mission directs and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission — keep playing the story in order and it will unlock in its turn.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long grind and the second gold trophy: finish the story, all eight stranger strands, the collectibles, the activities and the challenges, then check the in-game completion stat to see what is left. Save it for last, just before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, airtime, near misses and similar driving feats — they add up across free roam, so fold them into normal travel instead of grinding them all at once. Ramps and long jumps help the count climb faster.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample everything the map offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest — one go at each type is enough, and it is a good early tour of what Leonida offers.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the ranges weapon by weapon, learn each one's timing, and replay any challenge you miss — there is no penalty for retrying, so take the hard ones one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies (42 Shooting Range challenges)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 spots in total. Learn each course's corners, keep the drone low on the straights, and tick the locations off one by one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter the race types across the map and win 20 distinct ones — replaying a race you already won does not add to the count, so keep moving to new races.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge, out-fish him, and watch the line tension so the catch does not snap off before you reel it in.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade machine through to the end of a game — pick the one you are best at and finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's stranger strand mission by mission until its last one, and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's strand to its last mission — stranger missions appear as icons on the map, so check back whenever a new one shows up.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's strand through to its finale; the trophy pops when the last mission ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map — take every one you find, finish each strand to its last mission, and this silver pops after the eighth strand is done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Work through Randy's strand to its last mission and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand — the last mission of each strand is usually the hardest, so go in prepared.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. Visit each meditation spot and complete the meditation there; they are spread across the map, so tick them off while you explore other things nearby.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track the animal Bret asks for — follow tracks and signs in the wild — and take it down cleanly when you find it.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered around Leonida — in shops, hideouts and out in the world — so pick them up as you explore and finish three full sets to earn this silver.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK It interaction at 100 different spots around the map — it is a long count, so do a few whenever you pass a new spot rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — work through the challenge list, pick the easy ones first, and 50 completions unlocks this.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the law up to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears. A quiet alley or the water works well for shaking the search.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you when the wanted level clears — do it while the story still has you working together, or check whether your partner is available in free roam first.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three shops close together, rob one after another with your partner beside you, and keep the wanted level alive between them — do not let it clear until the third shop is done.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you for all three robberies in a row — do it while the story still has you working together.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter 100 different vehicles — a new one counts the first time you get in, so hop into anything unfamiliar you see parked or driving past.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with a group of enemies in front of you and drop five before it ends — a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout gives you the crowd you need.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport, grab a plane, and leave by an unscheduled route — off the runway and into the sky, not through the terminal.
trophies.missable_note: A one-off stunt at the airport — get it done the first time you reach VCIA, while the airport is open to you.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Get into a Rhino tank situation — steal one from the military or survive one rolling toward you — and the trophy pops. High wanted levels are the quickest way to meet one.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the approach, stay out of sight lines and cameras, take what you came for, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.missable_note: One clean run matters — if you are spotted, the attempt fails, so plan the approach and go in quiet.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time — plan the getaway before you go in, because the escape is half the job.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash, and lose the heat before it catches up with you.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas of the map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner; the trophy pops when the last undiscovered area is revealed, so check the map for blank patches and go fill them in.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. Find one illegal operation per gang, rob it, and move on to the next gang's turf.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — a quiet moment in the middle of the story.
trophies.missable_note: A story-moment trophy — enjoy the view while the moment lasts, before the story moves on.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front window and keep going — the old-school way out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and see it through to the last frame.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Build the partnership up and do something together that draws a crowd — the moment comes as the story develops, so keep playing and it will arrive.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make story choices as they come — PSN tracks a count toward 500, so keep choosing whenever the game asks and this unlocks along the way.
trophies.missable_note: Choices only count when you make them — there is no way to go back and remake a story choice without replaying, so think before you pick.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies (PSN progress count)

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — the trophy is for the second attempt landing. If a mission or challenge beats you once, go straight back in and finish it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Keep an eye out for strange sights around Leonida — this one pops when you witness something out of the ordinary, so explore the odd corners of the map, not just the main roads.
trophies.missable_note: A chance encounter — keep your eyes open while exploring, especially in out-of-the-way places, because strange sights do not wait around.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, swing a melee weapon at someone beside the vehicle and knock them down — slow down next to a pedestrian and time the swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean — keep the bills flowing and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops around Leonida — big purchases like vehicles count fastest, so save this for when you are buying anyway.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Buy every garage property around the map; they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own through the Scooter Bros app — any ten will do, so use the ones you drive most.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — GTA 6 trophy list (official name, description and grade)
PSNProfiles — GTA 6 trophies
